title: The `podman farm rm` command is missing the `--ignore` option
body:
### Feature request description

Our other removal commands have `--ignore` as an option, allowing for removal operations to succeed even if what was being removed is already gone. Farms don't have that option.

### Suggest potential solution

Add a `--ignore` option to `podman farm rm` which causes "No such farm" errors to be silently ignored - the command should exit 0 with no errors if the farm does not exist and `--ignore` is passed.

### Have you considered any alternatives?

N/A
